name: [Portal] Site settings / homepage content store (DB + decision)
description:
### Summary

`GET /site` in the contract returns all of `partners_web`'s chrome copy — hero title/lead, a homepage quote, verified-level badge copy (gold/silver/bronze), section intros for professionals/requests/webinars, a references carousel, contact block, 404 text, and the category-listing's closing CTA card. Today that content is hand-edited WordPress ACF options; nothing manages it in cms4.

### Why?

Without storage for this, the homepage and chrome copy stay hardcoded strings instead of editable content, defeating the point of moving off WordPress.

### What?

Decide and build storage for this content so it's editable per language without a deploy: one `partner_site_settings` row per language for the fixed fields, plus a `partner_site_reference` child table for the repeatable `references` list (text/name/position/url/image) — mirroring the recommendation/reference shape from the sibling DB task.

### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Decision recorded: JSON column(s) for free-text HTML blocks (e.g. `hero.leadHtml`, `contact.textHtml`) vs. fully normalized columns — proposed: JSON for HTML blocks, normalized rows for the repeatable `references` list
- [ ] `partner_site_settings` (`id`, `language`, the `SiteSettings` fields minus `professionalsCount` which is computed and minus `references`) + `partner_site_reference` (`id`, `language`, `text`, `name`, `position`, `url`, `image`, `sortOrder`)
- [ ] Migration under `migrations/2026/devrel/crm/CZ3TDR1-673/`, `make lint-migrations` passes
- [ ] A seed migration or admin form exists to populate the `cz` row before this feeds any real API response — an empty settings table breaks the homepage
